games.name: BloxLife [👽 SUPERNATURAL]
games.desc:
🌟 BloxLife - Life Simulator

This game is inspired by Candywriter LLC's BitLife. 

Live your life from birth to death! Make choices that shape your destiny. Will you become rich, start a family, or end up in prison?

⭐ FEATURES:
• Age up year by year and manage your health, happiness, smarts & looks
• Get married, have kids, and continue as your child when you die
• Work jobs, go to school, or start your own business
• Invest in stocks and crypto with live price updates
• Buy houses, cars, and boats
• Build relationships with family and friends
• Join the military or become a criminal
• Random events every year keep it interesting
• Start a business
• Become the PRESIDENT?!

💰 MAKE MONEY:
Trade cryptocurrency and stocks with real charts. Buy real estate and collect rent. Work your way up to high-paying careers. Every life is different!


Your choices matter. Start your life now!
All events are fictional and not based on real life events.

games.name: [HALLOWEEN] TECHY
games.desc:
Techy is a fast-paced FPS (first-person shooter), based on complex movement mechanics and adapted for the duels gameplay format

⚠️ This game is difficult; it includes MOVEMENT INACCURACY (you cannot move and be accurate with your gun)

- Hop on the duels pads in the lobby to get started
- Press the practice button or enter the practice portal and refine your skills
- Press PLAY to access a wide variety of game modes such as FFA and SURF
- Complete daily and seasonal quests to earn rewards
- Use coins and premium currency to buy cases and unlock rare gun skins and cosmetics

Experienced players, please help teach newer players how to also enjoy this type of gameplay. Join our socials to learn more about mechanics and get involved with the community 👍

⚠️ This game is in an Alpha-Testing stage; please expect bugs and unfinished content
⚠️Cheaters/exploiters/Farmers will be permanently banned.
